race.comment: SUPER WONDER (10) is a progressive type who was off the mark with a big three length win on the Parks track last time. Fitter again and has good upside. Worth following up. DAMELLI (13) resumes from a long break but has been fitted with three trials. Has won fresh and showed plenty of ability so far. Goes close if on song. FILL A PROMISE (7) was narrowly beaten into second when second up last start at this track over 1050m. Among the main chances. HARMONIC DANCER (11) will break from a tough gate but has the ability and must be included. MADAM JEANETTE (14) was beaten only half a length last time and is one of the chances.
